purpose: Durable tracked record of the independent HTSlib/pysam agreement check for the corrected custom BGZF/tabix fragment reader. The raw machine-readable output lives in the gitignored working copy reports/generated/reader_correction_20260921/reader_oracle_htslib.json and is reproduced here so the independent validation survives without the ignored directory.

oracle.note: pysam opens the remote bgzf and its .tbi directly and is not a wrapper around the custom parser, so it is a genuine second path rather than a re-decode with the same code.

command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src:scripts <pysam-venv>/bin/python scripts/validate_reader_against_htslib.py --fragment-url https://datasets.cellxgene.cziscience.com/46b43994-2af5-4359-bf75-3314a0d3a7a5-fragment.tsv.bgz --index-url https://datasets.cellxgene.cziscience.com/46b43994-2af5-4359-bf75-3314a0d3a7a5-fragment.tsv.bgz.tbi --region chr1:125181130-125182104 --region chr1:145996263-145997154 --region chr21:34790000-34792000 --out reports/generated/reader_correction_20260921/reader_oracle_htslib.json
environment_note: The isolated pysam virtual environment was created outside the shared .venv-p22 and was removed after use; the shared environment was not mutated. Re-running the command requires recreating that isolated pysam environment.

covers: a record split across two BGZF members

limitations: Agreement is on per-barcode fragment counts for four local and three remote regions; it is not an exhaustive sweep of the asset.
The remote case reads bounded windows, not the full 25.5 GB fragment file.
